fullBio.en: Marina Snyder is the owner of I Am Going To Canada and a regulated immigration consultant. She has a background in Business Administration and International Commerce and completed the Canadian Immigration Law, Policies and Procedures program at the University of British Columbia. Marina also went through the experience of immigrating to Canada herself.
fullBio.fr: Marina Snyder est propriétaire de I Am Going To Canada et consultante réglementée en immigration. Elle possède une formation en administration des affaires et en commerce international et a terminé le programme Canadian Immigration Law, Policies and Procedures de l’Université de la Colombie-Britannique. Marina a elle-même vécu l’expérience d’immigrer au Canada.
fullBio.pt: Marina Snyder é proprietária da I Am Going To Canada e consultora de imigração regulamentada. Tem formação em Administração de Empresas e Comércio Internacional e concluiu o programa Canadian Immigration Law, Policies and Procedures da University of British Columbia. Marina também viveu pessoalmente a experiência de imigrar para o Canadá.

fullBio.en: Aline Costa is a regulated Canadian immigration consultant and a graduate of Bow Valley College’s Immigration Consulting program. Before immigrating, she practiced law in Brazil and earned an MBA in Insurance Law from Universidade Candido Mendes in Rio de Janeiro. She has lived in Canada with her family for more than 15 years, bringing together her legal education, professional experience and personal experience as an immigrant.
fullBio.fr: Aline Costa est consultante réglementée en immigration canadienne et diplômée du programme Immigration Consulting du Bow Valley College. Avant d’immigrer, elle a exercé comme avocate au Brésil et a obtenu un MBA en droit des assurances à l’Universidade Candido Mendes, à Rio de Janeiro. Elle vit au Canada avec sa famille depuis plus de 15 ans, alliant formation juridique, expérience professionnelle et vécu personnel de l’immigration.
fullBio.pt: Aline Costa é consultora de imigração canadense regulamentada, formada em Immigration Consulting pelo Bow Valley College. Antes de imigrar, atuou como advogada no Brasil e possui MBA em Direito Securitário pela Universidade Candido Mendes, no Rio de Janeiro. Vive no Canadá há mais de 15 anos com sua família, unindo formação jurídica, experiência profissional e vivência como imigrante.
